question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文的主要贡献是引入了一个公开可用的大规模数据集FEVER，用于从文本来源进行事实提取和验证。该数据集包含185,445个通过修改维基百科句子生成的声明，并由标注者分类为支持、反驳或信息不足。论文还开发了一个流水线方法，并展示了该数据集对声明验证任务的挑战性。

gold_evidence.text: In this paper we introduce a new publicly available dataset for verification against textual sources, FEVER: Fact Extraction and VERification. It consists of 185,445 claims generated by altering sentences extracted from Wikipedia and subsequently verified without knowledge of the sentence they were derived from. The claims are classified as SUPPORTED, REFUTED or NOTENOUGHINFO by annotators achieving 0.6841 in Fleiss κ.
Thus we believe that FEVER is a challenging testbed that will help stimulate progress on claim verification against textual sources.
In this paper we have introduced FEVER, a publicly available dataset for fact extraction and verification against textual sources.

title: Unsupervised Dual-Domain Memory Model for Time Series Anomaly Detection
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是一种基于双域记忆模块的时间序列异常检测方法（DMemAD）。其框架采用编码器-记忆-解码器结构，包含季节性-趋势分解Mamba（STD Mamba）、双域记忆模块和非线性解码器模块。核心在于通过双域记忆模块分别存储时间序列中季节成分和趋势成分的正常模式，并利用残差更新机制动态调整原型特征与当前重构特征之间的差异，以避免记忆退化问题。

gold_evidence.text: In this paper, we propose a time series anomaly detection method based on dual-domain memory module (DMemAD). The core of the framework lies in a dual-domain memory module for storing the normal patterns of seasonal and trend components in time series.

The proposed model architecture with a dual-domain memory module mechanism is illustrated in Figure 1. This framework primarily adopts an encoder-memory-decoder structure, comprising a Seasonal-Trend Decomposition Mamba (STD Mamba), a dual-domain memory module, and a non-linear decoder module.

we propose a residual-based memory module updating mechanism, which avoids the memory degradation problem by dynamically adjusting the amount of difference between the prototype features and the current reconstructed features.

title: Hardness-Aware Dynamic Curriculum Learning for Robust Multimodal Emotion Recognition with Missing Modalities
question: 这篇论文报告了哪些关键实验结果？
gold_answer: 该论文在IEMOCAP和CMU-MOSEI两个基准数据集上，针对六种缺失模态条件进行了实验。实验结果表明，所提出的HARDY-MER方法在各项指标上均优于现有最先进方法，取得了新的最佳结果。具体地，在IEMOCAP四分类任务上，HARDY-MER的平均加权准确率（WA）和未加权准确率（UA）分别达到0.7556和0.7542。在CMU-MOSEI数据集上，HARDY-MER在ACC和F1指标上分别提升了0.0132和0.0163。此外，消融实验验证了直接硬度和间接硬度模块的有效性，索引构建策略实验表明文本索引适合内积距离，而声学和视觉索引适合L2距离。

gold_evidence.text: Table 1: Performance comparison with state-of-the-art methods (SOTA) under six possible missing modality conditions on two benchmark datasets. “Average” refers to the average performance of the models across all six missing modality conditions. The best results in each dataset are highlighted in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.

Results show that using L2 distance for the text index (T-L2) consistently degrades performance, especially in text-only or text-involved settings (e.g., t, at, tv), highlighting the suitability of inner product for normalized textual embeddings. In contrast, switching to cosine similarity for acoustic (A-IP) or visual (V-IP) indexing reduces accuracy, with V-IP showing the most notable drop, particularly under visual-only input. These findings suggest that L2 distance is more effective for acoustic and visual features, which typically retain important magnitude information.
Experiments show HARDY-MER outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and to our knowledge, it is the first to integrate retrieval and curriculum learning in this setting.

title: LES-CLIP: A Lightweight Emotion-Sensitive Adaptation of CLIP for Precise Similar Emotion Discrimination
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文提出LES-CLIP，一种轻量级、情感敏感的CLIP适配模型，用于高精度情感识别。它通过引入面部关键点、专家感知路由和提示引导精炼等最小但有效的架构调整和对齐感知策略，激活CLIP潜在的情感敏感性，同时保留其原始架构。为了增强在类别不平衡和语义模糊下的判别能力，提出了一种新颖的LES混合损失。实验表明，LES-CLIP在标准视觉FER基准上以显著更少的参数和更快的收敛速度达到了最先进的性能。

gold_evidence.text: We propose LES-CLIP, an emotion-sensitive and parameter-efficient adaptation of CLIP, designed for high-precision emotion recognition. LES-CLIP mitigates CLIP’s tendency to confuse visually similar emotions during alignment by introducing minimal yet effective architectural adaptations and alignment-aware strategies. Specifically, we incorporate facial landmarks, expert-aware routing, and prompt-guided refinement to activate CLIP’s latent emotional sensitivity while preserving its original architecture. To enhance discriminability under class imbalance and semantic ambiguity, we introduce a novel LES hybrid loss. Extensive experiments on standard visual FER benchmarks demonstrate that LES-CLIP achieves SOTA performance with significantly fewer parameters and faster convergence.

title: MGHFT: Multi-Granularity Hierarchical Fusion Transformer for Cross-Modal Sticker Emotion Recognition
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括三个方面：第一，设计了一个多视角贴纸解释器，利用多模态大语言模型将贴纸分解为多个视角，提供多视角描述，从而对齐人类感知模态以丰富对贴纸的理解，并引入MLLM知识提升情感识别性能。第二，设计了一种层次化融合机制，在PVT骨干网络的不同阶段注入多视角文本语义，通过全局和局部粒度的注意力与对比学习，丰富语义表示并增强情感识别性能。第三，提出了一种新颖的文本引导多模态融合注意力机制，利用多视角文本描述引导文本与视觉模态的整合，增强模型对贴纸上下文知识和视觉内容的理解。

gold_evidence.text: We design a multi-view sticker interpreter that utilizes MLLMs to decompose stickers into multiple views, providing multi-view descriptions, thereby aligning human perceptual modalities to enrich the understanding of stickers. By introducing the knowledge of MLLMs, our model further improves the performance of emotion recognition.

We design a hierarchical fusion mechanism that injects multi-view textual semantics into different stages of visual feature extraction on the PVT backbone. By leveraging attention and contrastive learning at both global and local granularity, our approach enriches semantic representation and enhances emotion recognition performance.

We propose a novel text-guided multimodal fusion attention mechanism that leverages multi-view textual descriptions to guide the integration of textual and visual modalities, enhancing the model's understanding of both the contextual knowledge and visual content of stickers.

title: Smooth Online Multiple Appropriate Facial Reaction Generation
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是PFLPosNet框架，该框架在预处理和后处理阶段分别引入Pose-aware Facial Behavior Localization（PFL）和PosNet。PFL预处理策略保留人脸视频中的头部运动并去除无关背景，使模型能生成包含头部运动的面部反应；PosNet后处理策略动态调整生成面部反应的头部姿态，确保相邻片段之间的时间一致性和自然头部过渡，从而提升视觉连续性和平滑性。

gold_evidence.text: we propose a novel and generic PFLPosNet framework which addresses the aforementioned problems at both pre-processing and post-processing stages, where a new pose-aware face behavior localization method PFL is introduced to retain the head pose displacement information from the source data. In addition, the framework proposes a real-time head pose adjustment method, PosNet, to ensure continuity and smoothness in the visual output of the model when using data with correct head pose displacement.

The proposed Pose-aware Facial Behavior Localization pre-processing strategy specifically retains head motions of face videos while removing unnecessary backgrounds, allowing the MAFRG models not only additionally considers speaker head motions compared to existing online MAFRG approaches but also enforces the MAFRG models to generate facial reactions with head motions rather than facial behaviours only (addressing Problem 1). Furthermore, to ensure the visual quality of the generated AFRs, the pose-aware post- processing dynamically adjusts the head poses from the generated AFRs, ensuring the temporal coherence and natural head transitions between adjacent AFR segments (addressing Problem 2).

title: EEG-SCMM: Soft Contrastive Masked Modeling for Cross-Corpus EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是软对比掩码建模（Soft Contrastive Masked Modeling, SCMM）框架。SCMM将软对比学习与混合掩码策略相结合，以捕捉人类情绪中固有的“短期连续性”特征，从而生成稳定且可泛化的脑电图表示。此外，还引入了一个相似性感知聚合器，用于融合语义相关样本的互补信息，增强模型的细粒度特征表示能力。

gold_evidence.text: This paper proposes a novel SCMM framework to tackle the critical challenge of cross-corpus generalization in the field of EEG-based emotion recognition. Unlike traditional CL-based models, SCMM integrates soft contrastive learning with a hybrid masking strategy to effectively capture the "short-term continuity" characteristics inherent in human emotions and produce stable and generalizable EEG representations. Additionally, a similarity-aware aggregator is introduced to fuse complementary information from semantically related samples, thereby enhancing the fine-grained feature representation capability of the model.

title: TeleAntiFraud-28k: An Audio-Text Slow-Thinking Dataset for Telecom Fraud Detection
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 该论文提出的核心方法是一个三阶段的数据集构建与评估框架：首先通过三种方法（真实数据ASR处理、大语言模型模仿生成、多智能体对抗框架）生成高质量、多样化的电话对话文本，然后利用音频理解模型和DeepSeek-R1大推理模型进行“慢思考”标注，生成包含显式推理过程的详细注释，最后建立统一的基准来评估模型在电信反欺诈任务上的表现。

gold_evidence.text: Our methodology involves a three-stage process. First, we generate a high-quality, diverse telephone-call dataset covering both telecom fraud and normal scenarios using three novel methods. Next, in a 'slow-thinking' annotation phase, an audio-understanding model's analysis and ASR outputs are used to prompt the DeepSeek-R1 large reasoning model, which in turn generates detailed annotations that include its explicit reasoning process. Finally, we establish a unified benchmark to evaluate various models on the telecom anti-fraud task.

title: Regulatory Focus Theory Induced Micro-Expression Analysis with Structured Representation Learning
question: 这篇论文的主要贡献是什么？
gold_answer: 本文的主要贡献包括：提出AC4AU，一种无需顶点帧的动作单元检测框架，解决了数据泄露问题并消除了手动标注顶点帧的需求；引入频率感知冗余分解器（FRD），通过去除直流分量保留交流分量作为动态情感变化，减少微表情表示中的冗余；以及通过AU特定专家路由实现动态、抗噪声的微表情表示。

gold_evidence.text: We propose AC4AU, an apex-free network for AUD that addresses data leakage concerns raised in CD6ME and eliminates the need for manually annotated apex frames. AC4AU integrates frequency-based representation decomposition with AU-specific expert routing, enabling dynamic and noise-resilient ME representations.

To reduce redundancy in ME representations, we introduce the Frequency-aware Redundancy Decomposer (FRD), which removes the Direct Current (DC) component and retains the Alternating Current (AC) component as dynamic emotional variations.
Inspired by Regulatory Focus Theory (RFT), FRD aligns with the dynamic nature of emotional expressions, ensuring the preservation of process-sensitive features.

title: Motion Matters: Motion-guided Modulation Network for Skeleton-based Micro-Action Recognition
question: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是什么？
gold_answer: 这篇论文提出的核心方法是Motion-guided Modulation Network (MMN)，专门用于基于骨架的微动作识别。MMN将运动信息分解为骨骼层面和时间层面两个不同层次：在骨骼层面，Motion-guided Skeletal Modulation (MSM)模块增强关键关节的骨骼特征；在时间层面，Motion-guided Temporal Modulation (MTM)模块捕捉连续帧之间的运动变化。此外，还提出了运动一致性学习模块，用于在多尺度特征中聚合细粒度运动模式。

gold_evidence.text: In this paper, we proposed a Motion-guided Modulation Network (MMN) specialized for Skeleton-based Micro-Action Recognition.
To inject the motion for spatio-temporal feature representation, MMN decomposes motion information into two distinct levels: the skeletal level and the temporal level.

At the skeletal level, the Motion-guided Skeletal Modulation (MSM) module reinforces the skeletal features of key joints, and the Motion-guided Temporal Modulation (MTM) module captures motion variations between consecutive frames. In addition, a motion consistency learning module is proposed to aggregate fine-grained motion patterns within multi-scale features.

gold_answer: 论文的局限性包括：当参与者眼睛不清晰时，模型的目光目标估计头可能给出错误结果，进而导致原子级和事件级理解出错；在跟随注视这一事件级类别上性能较低，因为该类别在数据集中频率最低且视觉上常模糊，易与联合注意或回避混淆；多任务训练引入梯度竞争，可能抑制稀有类别的学习。未来工作方向未明确提及，但可推测需要改进对低频率、模糊类别的处理以及提升模型在眼睛不清晰情况下的鲁棒性。

gold_evidence.text: However, when the eyes of the participants are illegible, our model’s gaze target estimation head might give a wrong gaze target result, which might cause a wrong prediction for atomic-level and event-level understanding.

However, in Table 4, we can find that the performance in Following gaze is lower than other ablated baselines. This is because Following gaze is the lowest-frequency event-level class in the dataset and is often visually ambiguous. Multi-task training introduces gradient competition, which can suppress learning for rare classes.

title: InterMind: Doctor-Patient-Family Interactive Depression Assessment Empowered by Large Language Models

gold_evidence.text: The contributions of our work are summarized as follows: • We propose an LLM-based depression assessment system that introduces a doctor-patient-family paradigm, enhancing caregiving and improving diagnostic efficiency. • We use prompt engineering to simulate counseling dialogues for data augmentation, and incorporate CoT and RAG to generate professional diagnostic reports from multisource data. Instruction fine-tuning significantly enhances LLM's capability in psychological assessment.

question: 这篇论文存在哪些局限性或未来工作方向？
gold_answer: 该论文的局限性包括：第一，患者和家属视角目前依赖于从现有来源生成的LLM模拟数据，可能无法完全反映真实情况；第二，尽管该方法旨在提高自动抑郁评估中的诊断效率和多角色交互，但其有效性仍需在真实临床环境中与医疗专业人员合作进一步验证。未来工作方向未明确提及。

gold_evidence.text: However, this work has several limitations. First, the patient and family perspectives currently rely on LLM-simulated data derived from existing sources, which may not fully reflect real-world situations. Second, although the proposed method aims at enhancing diagnostic efficiency and multi-role interaction in automatic depression assessment, its effectiveness still requires further validation in real clinical settings in collaboration with medical professionals.
